name: @agentproto/skill-pack-agentproto
description: @agentproto/skill-pack-agentproto — the agentproto-plugin skill pack: a 3-layer agent orchestration family (L0 map, L1 ap-* primitives, L2 groupers, L3 pb-* playbooks) plus app anatomy/serving and custom LLM endpoint guides. Source of truth for both the Claude Code plugin bundle (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/) and `agentproto install skill/<slug> --pack agentproto-plugin`. Edit src/skills/*, never skills/ or .claude-plugin/ directly — those are generated by `pnpm build`.
